scenes.summary: You find a watchguard responsible for protecting the monitoring instruments. He tells you that the Stockaders attacked the monitoring center in an organized fashion and clear objectives in mind. After making a call to Zhuang Fangyi, you decide to look for Mi Fu at the Field Logistics Depot to ask for Tangtang's whereabouts.

lines.text: I knew we had to keep an eye out for those dirty criminals, yet the captain kept defending them...
Those dirty sneaks slipped inside when we were changing shifts. They sabotaged our comms and monitoring facilities.
Thankfully, you intervened quickly and prevented things from getting worse.
Of course.
Thank you for your help, Endmin. But...
We do. Mi Fu just reported a new group of Stockade residents attacking the Field Logistics Depot. They're trying to get close to Wuling City.
I'll preach calm and restraint in Wuling City for now. As for the rest ... we'll be counting on you.
She knows that we're on good terms with Tangtang, and doesn't want us to be caught in a dilemma.
The Stockade residents did more than just disable our monitoring systems.
Endfielders...? Are the Cangzei pirates still out there?
Well, those attackers ran away once they saw how good we are at fighting.
Ugh. They spat on Wuling's goodwill and generosity...
Do we have another situation?
...Hmm. I know.
Heh! I was hoping you'd say that!
Mi Fu definitely has news about Tangtang. Let's head to the ⟦key|Field Logistics Depot⟧ right now!
I get the feeling that Tianshi Zhuang is trying to give us a hint...
We'll get the monitoring center back online shortly. Can you tell Tianshi Zhuang what happened here?

options: Why didn't you make a distress call?
She has a job, and we have our plans.
Time to talk to the Supreme Chief.
That doesn't sound like Tangtang at all.

r: Why didn't you make a distress call?
That doesn't sound like Tangtang at all.
She has a job, and we have our plans.
Time to talk to the Supreme Chief.

scenes.summary: You defeat the Stockaders who attacked the monitoring center but recognize none of them. This sudden attack and Tangtang going missing made you realize that something happened at Qingbo Stockade. You then hear someone's voice nearby...

lines.text: They packed up and ran at the first sign of trouble.
Someone definitely planned this attack...
But ... could the Stockade residents have avoided those Watchguards and Tianshi on their own?
They probably had help ... maybe from someone who knows this place very well.
Nothing is certain so far. We must find more information and intel.
I think I heard someone.
I'll never quit...
That's great... After all, it was Tangtang who helped us retake the monitoring center last time.
But Tangtang is the Chief of Qingbo Stockade... It doesn't matter if she knows of this incident. It won't bode well for her.
None of them are people we knew.
I don't think we know any of them.
Did something happen ... at Qingbo Stockade?

options: I still can't get a hold of her.
But it can't be Tangtang, right?

r: I still can't get a hold of her.
But it can't be Tangtang, right?

scenes.summary: You reach the Field Logistics Depot and see Mi Fu and her watchguards sorting out the defeated Stockaders. Mi Fu is worried about Tangtang as these incidents suggest that something strange had happened in Qingbo Stockade. Mi Fu and you reach a unanimous decision and decide to enter Qingbo Stockade directly to investigate.

lines.text: Hurh. Just gonna throw us in a cage?
Tsk. Chatty. Just do your part in the investigation.
You should know exactly what Qingbo Stockade wants.
...Bring this lot to Wuling and keep them there.
Mi Fu!
Why are you here...?
Endmin, I'm afraid the "Darkmask" card won't work this time.
Boss got me on this because she wants the situation contained.
So... You're willing to step into this mess?
Hah...! I see why my boss and Tangtang both enjoy your company so much.
No way! Tangtang... The Supreme Chief would never do that!
"Supreme Chief"...
Now that you've mentioned it, I'm getting worried myself...
If you intend to enter the ⟦key|Stockade⟧ and investigate, Endfield will offer full support.
I don't have time to worry about that little kitty... But her ability to keep her people in check worries me.
The other Tianshi treat Qingbo Stockade as less of a concern than the Aggeloi, but I don't agree...
Much appreciated. Did my boss send you here?
Tangtang? Hmph. I've been meaning to find her.
THIS IS OUR LAND! GET OUT!
Situation has changed. Time for an actual battle with actual weapons.
Her Stockaders wounded my people and tried to burn down the Field Logistics Depot.
There's been bad blood between the Stockade and the City for a decade. If this continues, nothing good will come of it.
Alright. Then let's be off.

options: We want to ask you about Tangtang.
Is Wuling running into a bigger problem?
We're also doing it for the Supreme Chief.
We want to help you too.

scenes.summary: You arrive at Qingbo Stockade. The gate to the fort is still tightly shut and you cannot get in touch with Tangtang. While worrying about her, Zhuang Fangyi suddenly calls you for an emergency.

lines.text: Oh, it's from Tianshi Zhuang.
It's supposed to keep out dangers that include the Blight, Landbreakers, Aggeloi ... and even Wuling City.
...No response?
This is the way into the ⟦key|fort⟧, right?
This gate feels like a physical manifestation of the gulf of misunderstanding.
But the Stockaders I've met are pretty friendly... The Stockade and the City just don't get along, despite all these years.
Don't think too much of it. Let's call ⟦key|Tangtang⟧ again.
That's true. Tangtang does not seem like the quiet and passive type...

options: Initiating call to the Supreme Chief.

r: Initiating call to the Supreme Chief.

lines.text: So, what about Tangtang?
Guess that's our only option...
Alright, team. We should head over once we're ready.

options: We'll return after checking on the ⟦key|monitoring center⟧.

r: We'll return after checking on the ⟦key|monitoring center⟧.

lines.text: *Sigh*
You hurt?
No. Just that I hardly did anything in this fight...
Captain Mi is probably gonna make me run fifty laps again...
